carry_anchor.pot_adapter_rule: POT-001 transform under carry_anchor = translation(0, 0.25, 0) x inverse(pot carry_grip local transform) = translation(0, 0.02, 0) for the r001 pot (carry_grip at y 0.23). The 0.25 m lift is a GAME-FIT adapter choice, not a carrying-technique measurement.
carry_anchor.measured_contact: carry_walk, 32 samples, actual POT-001 r001 GLB: pot base 8.0 mm above the highest hair vertex under the base; right-hand fingertips 1.3 mm into the pot wall (3 vertices, visible light contact); pot tilt <= 1.3 deg; anchor/pot base at about (±0.002, 1.666, 0.028) m
carry_anchor.note: In other clips the anchor follows the right hand and is not a meaningful pot position; the adapter must hide or detach the pot outside carry_walk.

animations.behaviour: quiet standing, two breaths, slight weight sway and head turn

animations.changed_in_r002: leg rotations only (thigh/shin/foot, <= 1.70 deg) to fix toe penetration
animations.behaviour: in-place treadmill walk, two steps per loop, step 0.50 m

animations.name: carry_walk
animations.changed_in_r002: leg rotations only (thigh/shin/foot, <= 1.59 deg); arms, head and anchor unchanged
animations.behaviour: in-place walk, pot carried on the head, steadied by the right hand; left arm swings

animations.name: work
animations.behaviour: generic two-handed alternating forward/back hand stroke, slightly stooped; no tool technique claimed (not the WORK-001 grinding target)

animations.name: rest
animations.behaviour: weight on left leg, hands loosely clasped in front, head lowered, slow breath

animation_notes: Root translation is stationary in every clip: no channel targets PERSON_rig; only the pelvis bone bobs/sways (unchanged from r001).
glTF has no loop flag. Godot import setting used and verified: person.glb.import _subresources animations/<clip>/settings/loop_mode = 1 for all five clips (checks/person.glb.import.recommended.txt).

Recommended additionally: nodes/PATH:AnimationPlayer/optimizer/enabled = false. With Godot's default keyframe optimizer the imported rest clip keeps only 1-44 of 61 keys per track, which puts the lowest vertex at -1.2 mm and lifts both feet up to 0.9 mm (checks/godot_check_default.json); with it disabled Godot matches the GLB exactly.

Lowest skinned vertex over each whole clip, 8 samples per key interval: walk -0.38 mm, carry_walk -0.36 mm, idle/work -0.002 mm, rest 0.0 mm (r001: -4.9 mm in walk and carry_walk). The residual is between-key interpolation; keys themselves are >= 0.
Move the character at 1.0 m/s for walk and 0.9 m/s for carry_walk (authoring rates unchanged).
reference_note: No pack source (A, B, C, T1) depicts people, clothing or hair; none was used for the figure. T1 (Godot 4.5 material/import docs) informed the culling and import-setting checks only.

deviations: Godot check projects, frames and XDG dirs were created in a scratch folder outside the repository (writes to /tmp are forbidden in this environment).
The r001 non-exported pot proxy was removed from the .blend; previews use the actual POT-001 r001 GLB imported at render time.
The palette PNG moved from textures/ to source/person_palette.png (byte-identical) so the return tree matches RETURN.md; the .blend references it relatively.
Residual between-key floor penetration of 0.36-0.38 mm remains in walk/carry_walk (within the >= -1 mm target).
Right-hand fingertips intersect the actual pot wall by 1.3 mm (3 vertices); kept because changing the hand would move carry_anchor.
